question: What exact generator/coefficient traits, same-field differences and fixed public-scalar equalities occur in all 21 recorded choices?

claims.text: The declared finite trait inventory and fixed envelopes are computed for all 21 choices and independently checked.
An exact finite fit does not establish the historical skip criterion.
No attack, DLP recovery or security proof follows from this trait inventory.
The synthetic-preflight scaling model is a planning estimate only, tested by the fixed watchdog; not a performance conclusion.

decision_rule.text: Admit only complete exact recomputation. Report all fixed recipes/envelopes and matched differences. A finite exact separator is descriptive and exploratory, never historical/security evidence.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact equality of all raw values and the recomputed headline summary.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Literal differences and retained-skip counts; no significance test.

inadmissible: No omitted P384/P521 controls or numeric encoding of unknown historical generators.
No post-outcome generator choice, coefficient-sign conflation or fitted conjunction.
No random-population significance, historical-use attribution, attack, DLP or performance claim.
